discovery_basis.why_relevant: ČNB as resolution authority publishes its general methodology for setting MREL — 2*(P1+P2) for large/systemically important/complex banks earmarked for bail-in, and (P1+P2) + coefficient*(P1+P2) for mid-sized, less complex banks resolved via transfer to a private acquirer — plus transition periods and an aggregate estimate that banks would need to add roughly CZK 120–140bn. source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR — tiskové zprávy (press releases, cs) as the ownership-decision channel
